title: Samsung Galaxy Studio Headphones: Leaked Design?
description: Samsung's upcoming Galaxy Studio headphones may have leaked as a rival to Apple's AirPods Max. Source: SamMobile This is a short news summary.
narration: Samsung may have just leaked its next big headphones. These headphones are positioned as a direct rival to Apple's AirPods Max. Reports say the design may have leaked, and Samsung is preparing an AirPods Max rival called the Galaxy Studio headphones. SamMobile has published a closer look at the upcoming Galaxy Studio headphones, according to the report. Notebookcheck reports the Galaxy Studio headphones design may have leaked as Samsung prepares its rival. Samsung is preparing its AirPods Max rival according to the report from Notebookcheck. The headphones are described as upcoming by SamMobile in its coverage. Subscribe for more daily tech news.
